title: 008 封无的嘴遁009 交锋与汇合

008 封无的嘴遁
下午的时候，关雨坐在一家快餐店，看着墙角的电视，心里不禁有些惊讶和莫名其妙。
张警竟然被抓了。
“还好我和他接触从来没有让他看见真面目，不过佐汉这下恐怕已经慌神了。”关雨心里暗道。
说实话，他不清楚警方是怎么发现张警，这让他有点恐慌，但自始至终他都没有暴露过真面目，警察理应找不到他。
“还有三个目标，看来要加快速度了！”关雨立即开始想下一步的计划。
至于佐汉，现在不能再接触，如果张警将佐汉供出来，那么接近佐汉将会十分的危险。
“还有三个目标，今晚一次过了结了吧！”关雨心里暗道，接着悠闲的吃着迟来的午餐。
恐怕谁都想不到眼前这普通的青年手上可是有八条人命！
…………
此时佐汉已经在收拾东西，他要赶紧离开天朝逃回墨西哥，不然张警一旦供出他的话，他就完蛋了。
“该死，狗屎，那白痴果然信不过。”佐汉骂骂咧咧，手脚却不慢，将需要用到的东西全都放进行李箱中。
收拾好东西，快速下楼将行李箱甩进面包车，他立即上车向着国际机场的方向开去。
…………
警局之中，此时在陈同和老流氓的陪同下，封无见到了张警，此时张警神色憔悴，两眼带着重重的黑眼圈。
无数个日夜，他做梦梦到自己被一群警察按在地上，然后被押上警车。
今日这个梦终于还是成为了现实。
“张警，二十九岁，初中学历，曾经因为争执失手杀死监工吴某，然后潜逃。我很好奇，既然你已经算是潜逃成功，为什么又要出来杀人？”封无看着资料，抬头看向张警。
张警并没有开口，此时他内心疲惫，却并没有放弃希望，这次杀了那么多人，如果一般情况他肯定立即绝望，但他知道他还有希望。
这几天做任务，其中一个老外爆出了一张符纸，他趁骷髅人没有注意悄悄收入了背包，那是一张传送符。

只不过在他被逮捕的时候因为太过紧张，才忘了使用，不过现在并不迟！
这张传送符也有限制，因为它是一张对人传送符，你必须知道玩家的姓名和ID，这样一来就可以使用。
而张警所知道的人只有一个，那就是佐汉，而那神秘莫测，自称是‘零’的人，真实姓名他却不知道而零是不是他的ID也难说。
“张警，我知道你还有同伙，但你认为你的同伙会来救你？”陈同这时候不合时宜的开口说道，之前进来的时候，他就听封无说过，这个张警必定还有同伙，这次就是想要撬开他的嘴，知道那些同伙的消息。
封无皱了皱眉头，陈同的开口打断了他的节奏，原本他是准备一点一点的瓦解张警的心理防线。
“同伙？”
张警忽然神经质的笑了，疯狂的大笑，他可没有什么同伙，不过现在他绝对不会供出佐汉，因为他还要靠佐汉救命，至于零那个危险的家伙，他可不敢说出来，谁知道那家伙手里有没有什么危险的东西能够探知自己的情况。
“我就说，这种温和的手段怎么可能有用，还是让我来吧！”老流氓这时候开口说道。
老流氓走上前，直接一把抓住张警的头发，将张警的头扯的后仰，这时候老流氓开口道：“小子，老子告诉你，像你这样的2逼，老子见的多了，你现在嘴硬是吧，不过很快你那张破嘴就会像菊花一样，什么屎都给老子吐出来。”
“老流氓，这不合规矩吧？”陈同开口道。
老流氓拍了拍张警的脸，笑道：“对付这种人，讲规矩没用，还不如直接严刑逼供。”
说话的时候老流氓还轻轻的踢了张警的小腿一下，疼的张警呲牙咧嘴，大汗淋漓，要知道他的小腿可是被封无开枪射击，刚刚也只是挖出子弹进行了简单的治疗包扎。
虽然疼痛，但他却依然不开口，此时他在等一个机会！
“你们两个先出去，我和他单独说几句。”封无这时候皱着眉头开口道。
老流氓和陈同都知道封无的厉害，听了点点头，老流氓道：“我先出去抽根烟，小陈，我们走。”
两人出去后，封无盯着张警，但他什么都没有说。
“你不用费心机了，我什么都不会说的。”封无的眼神让张警十分的不自在，那眼神就像是恐怖的怪兽，要将他吞食的连渣滓都不剩，在压力之下，张警硬气的开口道。
封无这时候微微一笑，拿起桌子上的杯子喝了一口水，然后道：“像你这样的人，我之前遇到过大概二十多个，你知道他们相同之处是什么吗？”
张警看着封无，却并没有说话。
“准确的数字是二十四个，他们相同之处就是还留有底牌在手，因为二十四个人最后都有人来营救，其中有九个在押送前往加利福尼亚州立监狱的时候在同伙来营救的时候成功逃脱，而剩下的十五位则在营救时的枪战之中死亡，你的表情就让我想起他们。”封无淡淡的说道。

张警吞了吞口水，依然不说话，他可没有想过谁来营救自己，只不过他有自己的底牌而已。
封无继续开口道：“我知道你有两个同伙，不过他们应该并不是伙伴，你第一次杀人，那时候我想你还是独自一人，后来才和那两人合作，所以你的底牌应该更神秘一些，就像之前你在下水道逃避追捕时手中凭空出现的刀。”
张警听到封无的话，心中猛的抽搐，这家伙看到了。他从背包里面拿出刀的动作，其实他已经做的相当隐秘，没想到这家伙那么眼尖，这下事情麻烦了。
封无微笑道：“我的视力非常好，一直保持在1.0，所以不会有看错的可能性，我想那是一种类似于超能力一样的能力，对吧。”
张警吞了吞口水，他现在真的怕了，这家伙根本就是个妖孽。
“你不用说话，只需要听我说完，然后我再提问。你的能力或许可以帮你逃跑，不过应该需要发动的时间，而这段时间应该足够我将你击毙！”封无微笑着说道，随即从西服中拿出手枪指着张警的眉心。
张警顿时额头冒出冷汗，这家伙不会来真的吧？
“忘了说，我并不是警察，只是一个侦探，不过我的雇主来头很大，大的就算我杀了你，也可以担保我不会受到法律的制裁，现在你能够好好配合我了吗，或许这样我会给你离开的机会。”封无微笑道。
张警看着黑洞洞的枪口，心脏都要跳出来，他没有使用过传送符，他不知道传送符使用的时候是什么效果，所以一旦他使用，如果他不是立即消失，那么绝对会被一枪爆头，张警他赌不起。
经过一番心理斗争，张警忽然吐出一口气，道：“我说，求你别把枪对着我。”
“很好，看来我们达成了共识，不过我还是丑化说在前头，我在美国是有名的神枪手，虽然还不是百发百中，但移动中的目标也能够十枪九中。”封无微笑道，说话的时候顺便将手枪垂下，不对着张警。
张警连连点头，虽然他杀过人，心里素质也比一般人要强，但还没有强大到可以忽视生死。
“现在开始，我提问你回答，相信以你的智商，想要欺骗我是不太可能，我的智商是159，仅差爱因斯坦一点而已！”封无淡淡的说道。
张警这下总算知道自己为什么被抓捕了，他之前有想过是不是佐汉或者零出卖了自己，现在看来恐怕是被这个高智商的侦探发现了自己的蛛丝马迹。
不过说实话，和这种高智商的人面对面的说话，绝对是压力山大的事情。
“明白了吧？那么我现在开始提问，你们的具体任务是什么？我之前曾经推断过你们是精神病人，毕竟毫无理由的杀人确实让人难以接受，但当我发现你们三个人一起联合的时候，我就推翻了这个想法，那时候就算是我也想不通原因，直到你使出那奇妙的能力，我想应该是谁赋予了你们特殊的能力，然后对你们下命令，让你们做出杀人这样的行为。”封无说道。
张警本来不想回答，但看到封无手中的枪有意无意的指向他，他吞了吞口水，嘶哑的开口道：“系统颁布的任务是杀死十个不同阵营的人。”
“阵营应该就是国籍对吧，你刚刚说系统，也就是说赋予你们能力的并非是某一个人，对吧？”封无淡淡的说道。
张警点点头，道：“没错。”
“能为我说说系统究竟是什么，还有任务失败的话，惩罚是什么，你的能力麻烦也说一下。”封无继续说道。

张警心里挣扎了一下，他不想回答封无的问题，这家伙太聪明了，聪明的让人恐惧，继续回答的话，恐怕所有的秘密都会被掏空。
但当他看到封无冰冷的眼神还有那随时会射出子弹夺取他性命的手枪，他还是屈服了。
张警缓缓开口道：“系统是什么，我也不知道，我是在一条小巷拾取到一张类似门票的纸张，上面写着《地球OL》激活码，我撕开之后系统就自动出现了，然后它就发布了杀人任务，如果失败的话就会变成丧尸，还有我并没有什么能力，我手里忽然出现刀是因为这个游戏自带背包，可以将东西放在里面。”
“这样说来世界末日恐怕不远了。”封无听了眉头皱起，淡淡的说道。
张警一愣，惊讶道：“你也这样认为？”
那个‘也’字，在一般人心里或许会认为是张警也认为这样，但封无却知道张警所指应该是另有其人，恐怕是他的同伙之一。
封无微笑道：“还有谁也这样想？”
“嗯，零也是这样认为的。”张警点头道。
封无皱眉道：“零是ID？”
content_en:
008 Feng Wu’s Mouth Escape
In the afternoon, Guan Yu was sitting in a fast food restaurant, watching the TV in the corner, feeling a little surprised and confused.
Police officer Zhang was actually arrested.
"Fortunately, I never let him see his true face when I came into contact with him, but I'm afraid Zuo Han is panicking now." Guan Yu thought to himself.
To be honest, he didn't know how the police found Officer Zhang, which made him a little panicked, but he had never revealed his true identity from beginning to end, and the police should not be able to find him.
"There are still three goals. It seems that we have to speed up!" Guan Yu immediately began to think about the next plan.
As for Zohan, we can no longer contact him now. If Police Officer Zhang confesses Zohan, it will be very dangerous to get close to him.
"There are still three goals, let's finish them at once tonight!" Guan Yu thought to himself, and then ate his belated lunch leisurely.
I'm afraid no one would have thought that this ordinary young man in front of him had eight lives in his hands!
…………
At this time, Zohan was already packing his things. He had to leave China and flee back to Mexico, otherwise he would be finished once Police Zhang confessed to him.
"Damn, shit, that idiot really can't believe it." Zohan cursed, but his hands and feet were not slow, and he put all the things he needed into the suitcase.
After packing his things, he quickly went downstairs and threw the suitcase into the van. He immediately got in the car and drove towards the international airport.
…………
In the police station, accompanied by Chen Tong and the old gangster, Feng Wu saw Officer Zhang. At this time, Officer Zhang looked haggard and had heavy dark circles in his eyes.
For countless days and nights, he dreamed that he was pushed to the ground by a group of police officers and then put into a police car.
Today this dream finally became a reality.
"Police Zhang, 29 years old, with a junior high school education. He accidentally killed supervisor Wu because of a dispute and then absconded. I'm curious, since you have successfully absconded, why did you come out to kill again?" Feng Wu looked at the information and looked up at Police Zhang.
Officer Zhang did not speak. At this time, he was tired inside, but he did not give up hope. He had killed so many people this time. Under normal circumstances, he would have immediately despaired, but he knew that he still had hope.
During the past few days while doing tasks, one of the foreigners revealed a talisman. He secretly put it into his backpack while the skeleton was not paying attention. It was a teleportation talisman.
It's just that he forgot to use it because he was too nervous when he was arrested, but it's not too late now!
This teleportation talisman also has limitations, because it is a person-to-person teleportation talisman, and you must know the player's name and ID so that you can use it.
There is only one person that Officer Zhang knows, and that is Zohan. However, the mysterious person who calls himself "Zero" does not know his real name, and it is difficult to say whether Zero is his ID.
"Police Zhang, I know you have accomplices, but do you think your accomplices will come to rescue you?" Chen Tong said inappropriately at this time. When he came in before, he heard Feng Wu say that this police officer must have accomplices. This time, he just wanted to pry open his mouth and get the news about those accomplices.
Feng Wu frowned. Chen Tong's words interrupted his rhythm. Originally, he was preparing to break down Police Zhang's psychological defense bit by bit.
"Accomplice?"
Police Zhang suddenly laughed nervously and laughed crazily. He didn't have any accomplices, but now he would definitely not betray Zohan, because he still relied on Zohan to save his life. As for the dangerous guy Zero, he didn't dare to tell him. Who knows if that guy has anything dangerous in his hand that can detect his situation.
"I just said, how can such a gentle method be effective? Let me do it!" The old gangster said at this time.
The old gangster stepped forward, grabbed Officer Zhang's hair, and pulled Officer Zhang's head back. At this time, the old gangster said: "Boy, I'm telling you, I've seen a lot of bitches like you, so you're being tough now, aren't you?But soon your broken mouth will be like a chrysanthemum, and I will spit out all kinds of shit. "
"Old gangster, isn't this against the rules? "Chen Tong said.
The old gangster patted Police Officer Zhang on the face and said with a smile: "To deal with such a person, it is useless to follow the rules. It is better to torture him directly to extract a confession. "
While talking, the old gangster lightly kicked Officer Zhang's calf. Officer Zhang grinned in pain and was sweating profusely. You must know that his calf had been shot by Feng Wu, and he had just dug out the bullet and performed a simple treatment and bandage.
Although it hurt, he still didn't speak. He was waiting for an opportunity!
"You two go out first, and I'll have a few words with him alone. "Feng Wu frowned and said.
Both the old gangster and Chen Tong knew how powerful Feng Wu was. They nodded after hearing this. The old gangster said, "I'll go out for a smoke first, Xiao Chen, let's go. "
After the two went out, Feng Wu stared at Police Zhang, but he didn't say anything.
"You don't have to worry about it, I won't say anything. "The look in Feng Wu's eyes made Zhang Jing very uncomfortable. The look was like a terrifying monster that wanted to devour him even to the dregs. Under the pressure, Zhang Jing spoke forcefully.
Feng Wu smiled slightly at this time, picked up the cup on the table and took a sip of water, and then said: "I have met about twenty people like you before, do you know what they have in common? "
Officer Zhang looked at Feng Wu, but did not speak.
"The exact number is twenty-four. The one thing they have in common is that they still have trump cards in hand, because twenty-four people were rescued in the end. Nine of them successfully escaped when their accomplices came to rescue them when they were escorted to the California State Prison, while the remaining fifteen died in the gunfight during the rescue. Your expression reminds me of them. "Feng Wu said calmly.
Officer Zhang swallowed his saliva and remained silent. He had not thought about who would rescue him, but he had his own trump card.
Feng Wu continued: "I know you have two accomplices, but they should not be partners. The first time you killed someone, I think you were still alone at that time, and then you cooperated with those two people, so your trump card should be more mysterious, just like the knife that appeared out of thin air in your hand when you were evading capture in the sewer. "
When Officer Zhang heard what Feng Wu said, his heart twitched violently. This guy saw it. When he took out the knife from his backpack, he actually did it quite secretly. He didn't expect this guy to be so sharp-eyed, and now things were in trouble.
Feng Wu smiled and said: "My eyesight is very good and has always been maintained at 1.0, so there is no possibility of seeing it wrong. I think it is an ability similar to a super power, right? "
Officer Zhang swallowed his saliva. He was really scared now. This guy was simply a monster.
“You don’t have to speak, just listen to what I have to say and then I’ll ask the questions. Your ability may help you escape, but it should take time to activate, and this time should be enough for me to kill you! "Feng Wu said with a smile, then took out a pistol from his suit and pointed it at Officer Zhang's forehead.
Police Zhang suddenly broke out in cold sweat on his forehead. Is this guy serious about coming?
"I forgot to mention that I am not a policeman, just a detective, but my employer is very powerful. Even if I kill you, he can guarantee that I will not be punished by the law. Can you cooperate with me now? Maybe I will give you a chance to leave. "Feng Wu said with a smile.
Police Zhang looked at the black muzzle of the gun, and his heart almost jumped out of his chest. He had never used the teleportation talisman before. He didn't know what effect the teleportation talisman had when used, so once he used it, if he didn't disappear immediately, he would definitely be shot in the head. Policeman Zhang couldn't afford the gamble.
After some psychological struggle, Officer Zhang suddenly exhaled and said: "I said, please don't point the gun at me. "
"Very good, it seems we have reached a consensus, but ILet's talk about vilification first. I am a famous sharpshooter in the United States. Although I am not always accurate, I can still hit the moving target nine times out of ten. "Feng Wu said with a smile, and while speaking, he lowered his pistol and did not point it at Police Zhang.
Officer Zhang nodded repeatedly. Although he had killed people and his mental quality was stronger than ordinary people, he was not strong enough to ignore life and death.
"From now on, I will ask questions and you will answer them. I believe that with your IQ, it is impossible to deceive me. My IQ is 159, which is only one point behind Einstein! "Feng Wu said calmly.
Police Zhang finally knew why he was arrested. He had previously wondered whether Zohan or Zero had betrayed him, but now it seems that this highly intelligent detective may have discovered clues about him.
But to be honest, talking face to face with such a highly intelligent person is absolutely stressful.
"Understand? So let me start asking now, what are your specific tasks? I had previously deduced that you were mentally ill. After all, killing people for no reason is really unacceptable. But when I found out that the three of you were united, I overturned this idea. At that time, even I couldn't figure out the reason until you used that wonderful ability. I think it was who gave you special abilities and then gave you an order to commit such acts of murder. "Feng Wu said.
Officer Zhang didn't want to answer at first, but when he saw the gun in Feng Wu's hand pointed at him intentionally or unintentionally, he swallowed his saliva and said hoarsely: "The task issued by the system is to kill ten people from different camps. "
"The camp should be the nationality, right? You just said the system, which means that it is not a certain person who gives you abilities, right? "Feng Wu said calmly.
Officer Zhang nodded and said, "That's right. "
"Can you tell me what the system is, what the punishment will be if the mission fails, and what your abilities are, please. "Feng Wu continued.
Officer Zhang struggled mentally. He didn't want to answer Feng Wu's question. This guy was too smart, so smart that it was scary. If he continued to answer, I'm afraid all the secrets would be revealed.
But when he saw Feng Wu's cold eyes and the pistol that could shoot out bullets and take his life at any time, he still gave in.
Officer Zhang slowly said: "I don't know what the system is. I picked up a ticket-like piece of paper in an alley with the "Earth OL" activation code written on it. After I tore it open, the system appeared automatically, and then it issued a killing mission. If it failed, it would turn into a zombie. Also, I don't have any abilities. The reason why a knife suddenly appeared in my hand is because the game comes with a backpack, and you can put things in it. "
"The end of the world is probably not far away. Feng Wu frowned and said calmly.
Officer Zhang was stunned and said in surprise: "You think so too? "
The word 'ye' may be thought by ordinary people to mean that Officer Zhang also thinks so, but Feng Wu knows that Officer Zhang should be referring to someone else, probably one of his accomplices.
Feng Wu smiled and said: "Who else thinks so? "
"Well, Zero thinks so too. "Police Zhang nodded.
Feng Wu frowned and said, "Zero is ID? "
